construction.crane_chart_scope: Explicit hypothetical hired-crane envelope; no extrapolation/interpolation and no claim that nominal300t rating applies at25m. Obtain configuration-specific signed chart/rigging/ground plan.

larger_crane_reference.max_reaction_scope: Manufacturer page8 global maximum, not a computed reaction for this lift. Conservative mat-area sensitivity only; actual outrigger reactions/ground treatment and mat bending must be designed.
larger_crane_reference.scope: Primary main-boom chart:26m row/32.7m column,204t ballast,360degreeEN. Uses nextlargerradius conservatively for25m; no interpolation/up-rating. Hookblock95t/2.6t listedpage8; reeving/wind/deflection/boomclearance and actual signed chart remain holds.

references.scope: European Commission2012 bridge worked examples: separate permanent/live/wind/fatigue/construction actions, concrete, foundations and seismic. Road-bridge examples; not a maglev or Iraq compliance route.

Primary worked-example structure: transfer/service stresses, losses, flexure/shear, bearings, pier and footing. Our SI material limits/factors are explicitly unqualified inputs, not imported AASHTO acceptance.

Handling/shipping stages, transverse sweep/tilt, transport support parameters and strength at release must be stated; our simple roll/bending screens do not implement full PCI lateral-stability design.
UK steelwork fabrication, bolting/tool access, preloaded/slip-resistant bridge joints, weld procedures and fatigue. Historical2010 guide, no current code compliance claim.
Primary/secondary rail vehicle structure and passive-safety scope. No GB category or EN12663 load case is claimed; full standard and Iraqi applicability need independent review.
Global pedological prediction maps with uncertainty; no bearing, pile resistance, groundwater, liquefaction or settlement values inferred. All50/100/150kPa scenarios are analyst hypotheses.
Manufacturer300t maximum is at3m radius and configurations vary. This package uses explicitly hypothetical radius-specific capacities and retains signed lift-chart/ground approval as a hold.

capture_moving_load.scope: Candidate six-car module force pattern scanned at0.25m; exact point-load equilibrium per placement. Scan discretisation and simply supported single-span/static factors do not validate train-track dynamics or continuous guideway behavior.
capture_moving_load.section_envelope_scope: Section-specific signed moments over every sampled train position plus the unloaded dead-load span; spatial and train-placement discretisation remain explicit.

capture_stress_screen.scope: Independent moving8shoe energy-average pattern. Actual50k shoe rating failure remains separate; no clipped force is used to make the concrete screen pass.

larger_crane_alternative.scope: Primary main-boom chart:26m row/32.7m column,204t ballast,360degreeEN. Uses nextlargerradius conservatively for25m; no interpolation/up-rating. Hookblock95t/2.6t listedpage8; reeving/wind/deflection/boomclearance and actual signed chart remain holds.

construction.scope: Exact counted gross lift including reinforcement/rails and rigging. Static roll is only a control, not the WSDOT/PCI imperfect-girder lateral stability method or a signed crane chart.

deflection.scope: Uncracked elastic simply supported integration; rail dynamics/cracking/effective stiffness excluded.

moving_load.scope: Candidate six-car module force pattern scanned at0.25m; exact point-load equilibrium per placement. Scan discretisation and simply supported single-span/static factors do not validate train-track dynamics or continuous guideway behavior.
moving_load.section_envelope_scope: Section-specific signed moments over every sampled train position plus the unloaded dead-load span; spatial and train-placement discretisation remain explicit.

prestress.hold: End-zone bursting/spalling, strand anchorage/debond procedure, loss/creep/shrinkage, ductility/strain compatibility, fatigue and development require qualified detailed design.

selected.accidental_scope: Sensitivity only; capture point forces and contact torsion require coupled nonlinear verification.

faces.attachment_scope: Actual bracket/crossmember, insulation and fastener design to concrete webs required; not implicitly supported.

guideway.scope: Magnetic return stock only; civil module must add actual crossmembers, fasteners, rail joints and maintainability. No beam, prestress or foundation acceptance.

rail_and_attachments.scope: Four continuous L-return rail sections are counted from the magnetic candidate; new RHS crossmembers/baseplates carry them to beam webs. Joint gap/fringing, rail fastening, concrete breakout and tolerance remain holds; anchor/rail bolt mass is not yet net-designed.
